### Stack & Responsibilities
- Backend-leaning full-stack engineer building APIs, data systems, and reliable crisis-support technology. Crisis Text Line provides free, 24/7 text-based mental health support.
Full-stack engineer building scalable crisis-support technology for Crisis Text Line

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Backend-leaning full-stack engineer building APIs, data systems, and reliable crisis-support technology. Crisis Text Line provides free, 24/7 text-based mental health support.
Full-stack engineer building scalable crisis-support technology for Crisis Text Line
Role description:
• Design, build, test, deploy, and operate core platform features
• Own full-stack features end-to-end in production
• Implement approved technical designs
• Develop and maintain APIs
• Work with relational databases and caching technologies
• Support queues, schedulers, and asynchronous processes
• Address technical debt and improve production reliability
• Strengthen tools and practices for safe software delivery
• Break down ambiguous technical challenges and deliver scalable, secure solutions
• Contribute to authentication, authorization, and platform security
• Improve service architecture, APIs, and system reliability
• Partner with product, design, and engineering peers
• Improve testing, CI/CD, observability, and developer workflows
• Participate in an on-call rotation for platform reliability
• Work primarily on backend systems while contributing across the stack as needed
Role requirements:
• Approximately three to five years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful backend or full-stack responsibilities
• Professional experience programming in at least one high-level language
• Experience developing and maintaining production APIs
• Experience working with SQL and relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL
• Experience testing, debugging, and supporting production software
• Familiarity with cloud-based environments such as AWS
• Experience working with automated CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows
• Ability to independently complete well-defined engineering work while asking questions and seeking full alignment when needed
• Ability to explain technical analysis, decisions, risks, and tradeoffs clearly
• Collaborative approach to working with engineering and cross-functional partners
• Commitment to building secure, reliable, and accessible technology for people with diverse needs and experiences
• Stable high-speed internet connection
• Primary residence and regular home work location must be in an approved U.S. hiring state
• No visa sponsorship available
• Preferred: PHP or Symfony; Golang; Node.js, React, or Redux; REST and GraphQL APIs; Redis; queues, schedulers, background processing, or event-driven systems; AWS services; Terraform; Datadog, Grafana, or comparable tools; CI/CD and deployment automation; availability, performance, security, and observability; service-oriented or API-first architectures; technical design reviews; mission-driven, regulated, safety-sensitive, or high-trust environment
Benefits:
• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision options
• Employer-funded HSA contributions
• Generous PTO, sick time, and 19 paid holidays with a winter break
• 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave after 26 consecutive weeks of service
• Monthly wellness and mental health stipends
• Home office and professional development stipends
• 403(b) retirement plan with employer contribution
• Sabbatical after 3 years of service
• Remote work arrangement
Tech stack:
AWS, Cloud, Grafana, GraphQL, JavaScript, MySQL, Node.js, PHP, Postgres, React, Redis, Redux, SQL, Symfony, Terraform, Go
Company sponsorship flag: sponsorsH1B=true.
